title: Photo-Enhanced Fingerprint Security: Defending Against Spoofing
content: Fingerprint recognition is one of the most popular biometric technologies that is used for protection of different applications, including individuals’ facilities and significant objects. Nevertheless, the modern trends in the development of the spoofing attacks such as the usage of artificial fingerprints that mislead the fingerprint sensors threatens the stability of the systems in question. This article presents an overview of the novel field of enhancing fingerprint security using photography that essentially improves the capability of the fingerprint recognition system against attacks using fake fingerprints. The present article turns to the updated trends of using imaging technologies to enhance the mechanisms of fingerprint security and, based on the review of the corresponding literature, reveals the major issues and perspectives of the further development of this field of study.
